import pytest
from workflow.runner import run_workflow


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: normalize QA issues
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
def _issues(out):
    qa = (
        out.get("qa")
        or out.get("resume", {}).get("qa")
        or {}
    )
    return qa.get("issues", [])
